_help: What works, shown on the ambassador's page and sent in plan.json as `playbook`. Lowercase, short, no links in the examples.
lead: the posts that work don't look like ads.
steps: scroll your school's feed first. see what's getting upvotes this week.
borrow the format, not the words: a question, a ranking, whatever everyone is reposting.
keep smooth out of the pitch. slip it in, or ask the question it answers.
when someone asks what smooth is, reply "Smooth for Students on the App Store". no link.
answering your own question? the app tags you OP. get a friend to answer, or own it.

examples.title: ask the question
examples.post: What do you guys use to stop missing assignments?
examples.reply: Smooth for Students on the App Store
examples.why: a pain everyone has, in nine words. smooth is an answer in the comments, never the post.

examples.title: slip it into a list
examples.post:
Post HOCO Frat Rankings 🔥🔥🔥🔥
S: [frat], [frat], [frat]
A: [frat], [frat]
B: Smooth, [frat]
C: [frat], [frat]
D: [frat]
examples.reply: Smooth for Students on the App Store
examples.why: a format that was already blowing up. smooth in the B tier made someone comment "wtf is smooth", and the answer got upvoted too.
